region.name: The Ashen Crown
region.description: A bleak frontier where old stone roads still cut through soot and cinder.

locations.name: Sootbound Crossing
locations.description: A ruined road crossing where caravan tracks vanish into the cinder.

locations.name: Resonant Forge
locations.description: A collapsed smithy where buried machinery still hums beneath the slag, as if the old bellows never stopped.

locations.name: Hollow Caravan
locations.description: A ruined traveling caravan lies beside the road: wagons split open, instrument cases blackened by fire, and a little wooden stage half-buried in ash.

npcs.name: Vahr
npcs.title: Forge Keeper
memory: Listens to the forge for signs that the buried machinery is waking.

npcs.name: Mara
npcs.title: Road Singer
memory: Says the old performers carried songs from settlement to settlement before the roads went silent.

quests.title: Silence the Forge
quests.description: Vahr wants the machine beneath the slag stopped before its resonance spreads down the road.

quests.title: The Last Chord
quests.description: Mara wants the old road bell recovered from the Hollow Caravan so the dead performers can finally finish their last song.

encounters.description: A welded guardian drags itself from the slag, still obeying a command from a dead workshop.
A pale performer rises beside the ruined stage, wearing a coat stitched from old banners and carrying the grief of an audience that never arrived.

atmospheres.text: Metal hums somewhere under your boots, keeping time with a heartbeat that is not yours.
Wind moves through broken instrument cases and hanging stage cloth. Somewhere among the wagons, a melody keeps trying to remember itself.

effects.text: A deep metallic note rolls through the forge, and the walls answer from somewhere below.
The forge answered the road with a buried metallic echo.
After dusk, several broken instruments answer one another across the wagons. The tune is slow, heavy, and impossible to place.
The Hollow Caravan sang without living performers.
